jwtCookieFix.rootCause: JwtStrategy only extracts tokens from Authorization header, not cookies

symptoms: Login works and cookies are set correctly
Authenticated endpoint (/buyer/cart/<email>) returns 401 'Invalid or missing JWT token'
Manual curl with Authorization header works
Browser cookies not being recognized by JWT guard

rootCause.description: JwtStrategy was configured to only extract tokens from Authorization header using ExtractJwt.fromAuthHeaderAsBearerToken(), ignoring cookies entirely

technicalDetails.guardBehavior: JwtAuthGuard injects cookie into header, but strategy doesn't read cookies directly

authenticationFlow: 1. User logs in → SetAuthCookieService sets httpOnly cookie with SameSite=none; Secure=true
2. Frontend makes request → Axios sends cookies with withCredentials=true
3. JwtAuthGuard runs → Attempts to inject cookie into Authorization header
4. JwtStrategy runs → Only looks for Authorization header, ignores cookies
5. Authentication fails → Returns 401 'Invalid or missing JWT token'

changes: Updated jwtFromRequest to use ExtractJwt.fromExtractors() with multiple extraction methods
Added primary extraction from Authorization header
Added fallback extraction from direct header
Added cookie extraction as final fallback
backend.code:
jwtFromRequest: ExtractJwt.fromExtractors([
  ExtractJwt.fromAuthHeaderAsBearerToken(),
  ExtractJwt.fromHeader('authorization'),
  (req) => req?.cookies?.token || null
])

changes: Added debug logging to track cookie transmission
Enhanced cookie injection logic with logging
